description: Check a site's legal pages — privacy policy, terms, cookie policy and imprint (those its homepage links, else the usual addresses): whether each is really there and more than a stub, the date it says it was last updated, which topics it covers (GDPR, CCPA, a DPA, subprocessors, cookies, children, retention), the consent manager and trackers the homepage loads, and the company its structured data names. Facts the pages state, never a compliance verdict. At most four pages as our crawler after robots.txt; stores nothing. at most 20 checks an hour per network and 30 an hour per site checked.

url.description: The public page to check (https://…). A bare host means its homepage.

name: check_legal_pages

checks.description: Fails first. `fix` is the one action to take; null on a pass.

facts.description: What was read, as labelled rows. From the site or a registry: unverified.

listing.description: Whether the site is listed on the directory: its page when it is (and claimUrl while nobody has proven they own it), where to list it when not.

toolUrl.description: The same check as a page on the site.

title: Check privacy policy & terms
